Who We Are
NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers, and potential to turn into performance. With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm — 220,000+ daily users from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

Your Role in Our Mission
As Product Manager — Trading Platform, Rules & Risk, you sit at the most consequential intersection in our product organisation — where trader experience meets financial integrity. You will lead the squad responsible for the rule engine that governs every CFD challenge: designing new challenge types, defining how rules are surfaced to traders, building the simulation and backtesting infrastructure that lets us model change before we ship it, and partnering with Trading and Risk Management to close off abuse vectors before they reach scale. Every decision you make carries direct financial consequence — and that weight is exactly what makes this role compelling.

How You'll Make an Impact
Challenge Design & Rule Architecture
•
Design and launch new challenge types (beyond Stellar, Express, Evaluation) targeting new trader segments and creating incremental revenue streams
•
Run competitive analysis on how other prop firms structure their challenges, rules, and risk parameters — ensure FundedNext’s rule design is differentiated and continuously innovated
•
Lead the CFDs Trading Rules & Risk squad — write specs for heavy backend algorithmic work including the rule engine, simulation tools, and backtesting infrastructure
Trader-Facing Experience & Communication
•
Define how trading rules are visualised on the trader-facing dashboard — work closely with the Trader Success squad to ensure rule statuses, drawdown levels, violation warnings, and account health are displayed clearly and accurately
•
Design and own the end-to-end rule violation communication process — define what triggers a notification, what the messaging says, which channel it goes through (in-app alert, email, dashboard warning), and how disputes are escalated and resolved
Internal Tooling & Simulation Infrastructure
•
Build internal admin tools requirements — define the interfaces that let the operations and risk team configure, monitor, simulate, and audit rules effectively
•
Partner with engineering to build rule simulation and backtesting tools — enable what-if analysis so the team can model rule changes against historical trade data before deploying them
Abuse Detection & Risk Partnership
•
Collaborate deeply with FundedNext’s Trading and Risk Management team on abuse detection and management — translate abusive trading patterns (rule loopholes, coordinated trading, hedging abuse) into product-level rule adjustments, detection parameters, and enforcement workflows
Measurement & OKR Ownership
•
Define and track squad OKRs: GP margin per challenge type, pass/fail ratios, rule-change impact modelling accuracy, false-positive violation rate, and trader dispute volume related to rules

What You Bring
•
5+ years of product management experience, with significant exposure to financial products, risk management, or trading systems
•
Strong quantitative and analytical skills — ability to build and interpret financial models, pass/fail simulations, and rule-change impact analyses
•
Experience with business rule engines, configuration-driven product logic, or algorithmic decision systems
•
Deep understanding of prop trading, CFD trading mechanics, drawdown calculations, and margin management — or demonstrable ability to learn complex financial domains quickly
•
Experience designing data visualisation for complex states — defining how rule statuses, account health, and violation warnings should be presented to both end users and internal operations teams
•
Strong process design skills — ability to define end-to-end communication workflows including trigger conditions, notification channels, messaging templates, and dispute escalation paths
•
Experience working with risk management, fraud, or compliance teams — translating business risk findings into systematic product-level adjustments
•
Understanding of abusive trading patterns in prop trading or financial markets (account manipulation, hedging exploitation, coordinated trading) and how to build product-level defences
•
Comfort with high-stakes decision-making where errors carry direct, significant financial consequences
•
Excellent collaboration skills with engineering teams working on heavy algorithmic and business-logic systems
•
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or equivalent experience)

Your Journey After Applying

30-minute HR Session with the Talent Acquisition team
•
60-minute Session with the Direct Supervisor
•
60-minute Session with Chief Strategy Officer

At NEXT Ventures, performance is more than numbers — it’s the pulse that drives innovation and impact. Formulate the company’s app development strategy, technical roadmap, and annual/quarterly development plan, combining the company’s business needs (digital currency trading, payment settlement) and industry technical trends (cross-platform development, app security, user experience optimization).

Determine the app technical architecture, development framework, and technology stack (such as iOS: Swift, Android: Kotlin/Java, cross-platform: Flutter/React Native), optimize the technical architecture, and ensure the scalability, maintainability, and security of the app.

Oversee the entire lifecycle of app development, including demand review, technical design, coding development, unit testing, integration testing, UAT testing, and launch, ensuring that the development work is completed on time, with quality and quantity.

Establish and improve the app security management system, formulate app security standards and specifications, and ensure that the app meets data security, user privacy protection, and digital asset security requirements.

Oversee app security development, conduct regular security audits and vulnerability scans, identify and fix security risks (such as data leakage, malicious attacks, and tampering), and ensure the security of user assets and transaction data.

Manage team performance, conduct regular performance reviews, motivate team members to achieve work goals, and retain core technical talents.

Communicate closely with product, trading, compliance, risk control, operations, and other departments to understand business needs, coordinate app development-related work, and ensure that app development is closely aligned with business development.

Cooperate with the backend development team to ensure the smooth docking of app and backend systems, and solve interface docking and data interaction problems.

Formulate the app development team’s budget plan, control development costs, reasonably allocate resources, and improve resource utilization efficiency.

Track and analyze project execution, conduct project summary and review, summarize experience and lessons, and continuously optimize project management processes.

Deep understanding of app development processes, technical architecture, and digital asset-related business models, with experience in leading the development and launch of large-scale mobile apps.

The Bullion Sales & Operations Director oversees Singapore’s bullion business, encompassing physical gold trading, gold-backed lending, and client gold funding activities. This role is responsible for obtaining and maintaining the company’s required registration and licence as a Regulated Dealer under the Precious Stones and Precious Metals (Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing) Act 2019 (PSPM Act).
The Director ensures full compliance with licensing conditions, while driving commercial growth, operational excellence, and secure delivery logistics across all gold trading and custody operations.

Licensing, Compliance & Regulatory Management
• Serve as Designated Officer and Licence Holder under the PSPM Act (MinLaw).
• Lead the company’s regulatory obligations, including AML/CFT framework, suspicious transaction reporting (STRs), and periodic compliance filings.
• Coordinate with Ministry of Law, MAS, and internal compliance teams for inspections, renewals, and ongoing audits.
• Maintain governance for both bullion operations and any related MAS licensing projects.
Bullion Sales, Trading & Market Development
• Drive physical gold and bullion trading across retail, institutional, and wholesale clients.
• Manage pricing strategy and spread optimization across client channels and trading platforms.
• Expand regional bullion client base — including banks, brokers, crypto platforms, and commodity firms — leveraging strong APAC market networks.
• Cross-sell bullion, FX, and structured products, promoting multi-asset integration for clients.
• Design and execute complex gold structures, including collateralised lending, swaps, and cross-guarantee facilities.
Operations, Trade Lifecycle & Risk Control
• Manage end-to-end trade operations, from order execution to final delivery and settlement.
• Oversee reconciliations between vault inventories, client ledgers, and trade systems daily.
• Ensure seamless integration between front-office trading and back-office operations.
• Implement strong risk management and operational control to minimize trade discrepancies.
Team Leadership & Development
• Lead and mentor a cross-functional team covering sales and operations
• Coach junior traders on bullion market operations, client engagement, and risk protocols.
• Foster collaboration between sales, technology, and compliance units to improve efficiency.
• Promote a culture of regulatory responsibility and client service excellence.

Qualifications & Experience
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or related discipline; CFA preferred.
• Minimum 10–15 years of experience in bullion, FX, or commodity trading, including leadership roles.
• Proven record of building and growing APAC client bases and cross-asset sales.
• Hands-on experience in trade lifecycle management, operations, and process automation.
• Deep understanding of Singapore’s PSPM Act, AML/CFT obligations, and MAS compliance standards.
• Proficiency in trading systems
• Bilingual in English and other Asian languages advantageous.

Core Competencies
• Strategic business development in bullion and FX markets.
• Expertise in collateralised trading and asset-backed financing.
• Strong command of regulatory frameworks and AML/CFT governance.
• Leadership and mentoring skills with cross-departmental coordination.
• Analytical problem-solving and process automation capability.
• High integrity, precision, and delivery excellence in all client transactions.

We’re looking for a Partner Acquisition Manager (PAM) to help scale our global partner ecosystem.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for finding, onboarding, and activating high-quality partners who bring new traders to the platform. You’ll own the journey from first contact through activation, working closely with partners to launch campaigns and reach performance milestones.

Partner Sourcing & Outreach

• Drive partners to reach Active status (5+ first-time deposits)

Required

• Experience in partnerships, sales, affiliate marketing, or business development within Trading industry.

• Strong communication and negotiation skills

• Comfort working with targets and KPIs

• Organized, proactive, and follow-up driven

• Experience using CRMs and digital tools

Nice to Have

• Experience in crypto, fintech, trading, or online platforms

• Familiarity with influencer or affiliate ecosystems

• Experience working with global partners

• High-impact role tied directly to growth

• Clear KPIs and ownership

• Exposure to global markets and partners

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially driven Relationship Manager to help build our UK presence. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and managing relationships with institutional clients — including asset managers, hedge funds, pension funds, insurance companies, and other financial institutions.

Client Relationship Management
• Prospecting and acquiring new clients and strengthening relationships, including asset managers, pension funds, hedge funds, and insurance companies.
• Introduce UK clients to the Swissquote Bank product and services.

Business Development & Growth
• Assist in establishing the relationship management department in the UK.
• Identify and cultivate prospects and new business opportunities.
• Initiate and lead new business meetings, closing sales with institutional and private clients

Applications will be accepted until the 31st of March.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an AI Infrastructure Engineer to design and build the foundational systems that power next-generation AI agents. This role sits at the intersection of research and production engineering, focusing on scalable long-term memory, knowledge graph infrastructure, and robust context management systems.

You will transform cutting-edge research concepts (e.g., Context Graphs, GraphRAG, agent memory architectures) into auditable, maintainable, and production-grade infrastructure that enables reliable, stateful AI systems.

What You’ll Be Doing

•

Architect and implement long-term memory infrastructure for AI agents, including auditable, versioned, and rollback-capable middleware that supports persistent, stateful reasoning.

• Design and own end-to-end GraphRAG and knowledge graph pipelines, from ingestion and schema design to graph indexing, retrieval optimization, and integration with LLM-based reasoning systems.

• Build scalable context management infrastructure, elevating context from prompt-level techniques to structured, maintainable systems such as Context Graphs that enable long-horizon and cross-session reasoning.

• Translate advanced agent research into production-grade systems, prototyping emerging architectures and establishing best practices for memory, retrieval, and infrastructure reliability.

• Ensure reliability, observability, and governance of agent infrastructure, including traceable memory operations, evaluation frameworks, and safeguards against drift and degradation.

What We Look For In You

•

PhD or Master's in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, Robotics or related field with at least 10 years of industry experience.

•

Possess a deep expertise in at least one of the following areas: long-term memory, knowledge graphs, or context management.

Nice to Haves

•

Experience in top-tier AI labs or Tech industry leaders

•

Experience in high-frequency trading, fintech, Web3, or crypto platforms is a strong advantage

•

Startups or research-intensive environments preferred; must be comfortable operating with ambiguity and speed

• Competitive total compensation package

• L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

• Various team building programs and company events

• Wellness and meal allowances

• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

• More that we love to tell you along the process!

As an Infra Product Manager, you will be responsible for the design, development, and lifecycle management of Web3 cross-business infrastructure products, with a focus on core components such as central data services, market data systems, labeling systems, asset category management, and algorithm platforms for Wallet, DEX and other businesses. You will collaborate closely with engineering, data, and business teams to ensure products meet the performance, security, and scalability requirements of Web3 businesses. This role demands strong product thinking, technical depth, and insight into the Web3 industry to help the team build an efficient and reliable Web3 Infra system.

What You’ll Be Doing

•

Central Data Services Management: Oversee the design of central data services for Web3 cross-business domains, including data collection, integration, storage, querying, and distribution. Ensure real-time data accuracy, security, and support for complex business needs and multi-platform environments.

•

Market Data System Development and Optimization: Contribute to the product design and iteration of a universal market data system, delivering real-time market data (e.g., price, trading volume, liquidity metrics). Support API and front-end integration while optimizing system performance for high-concurrency scenarios.

•

AI Trading Products: Able to design DEX AI Trading Products based on trading strategies, meme tokens, smart money signals, and leverage the latest AI technologies (AI Agent, LLM etc.)

•

DeFi Native: Have a solid understanding of Web3, including its core concepts, underlying blockchain technologies, and emerging ecosystems such as DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, and Layer 2 solutions. Stay closely informed about the latest industry trends, market dynamics, and technological developments, with the ability to quickly assess and adapt to new protocols, products, and narrative shaping space.

•

Onchain Data and Smart Contract Analysis: Conduct research on smart contracts, understand how Dapps and protocol works, design and improve product infra performance based on the protocol underlying mechanics, make sense of the onchain data whenever necessary.

•

Algorithm Development and Improvement: Design and iterate an algorithm to support on-chain data analytics, trading signal discovery, and risk control scenarios. Manage the integration, testing, and deployment of algorithm models to ensure efficiency and reliability of outputs. Collaborate with data analysts and data scientists to integrate machine learning or on-chain analytics models, elevating the intelligence of Infra products.

What We Look For In You

•

Education: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

•

Work Experience: At least 5 years of experience as a Product Manager. Preference for candidates with Web3 industry experience or expertise in infrastructure products (e.g., data services, labeling platforms, algorithm platforms).

• Technical Skills:

•

Experience with blockchain fundamentals, including smart contracts, on-chain data analysis, consensus mechanisms, and cross-chain technologies.

•

Familiar with onchain and web3 ecosystems, a genuine passion for the crypto industry and proactive engagement with the community are highly valued.

•

Proficiency in product management and system-design thinking is strongly preferred.

•

Proficiency in AI technology, Agent, LLM, and AI application experience is a huge plus.

•

Basic knowledge of algorithm platforms; familiarity with machine learning models or data analytics workflows is preferred.

•

Soft Skills:

•

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively bridge business and technical teams.

•

Strong user-oriented mindset, capable of designing products based on user pain points.

•

Robust problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick decisions in uncertain environments.

•

Fluent in English and Chinese.

Nice to Haves

•

Knowledge of Web3-related products and deep technical understanding of blockchain, smart contracts, and related technologies.

•

Experience with on-chain trading and an understanding of on-chain opportunity discovery processes.

•

Familiarity with tokenomics and an understanding of economic incentive mechanisms in the Web3 space.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

•

More that we love to tell you along the process!

In this role, you will collaborate closely with trading, risk, operations, and engineering teams to maintain high availability trading systems, support integrations with liquidity providers and internal systems, and continuously improve platform reliability. Your expertise in MetaTrader ecosystems and trading infrastructure will help sustain a secure and scalable trading platform.

How You’ll Make an Impact
MetaTrader Platform Ownership
•
Install, configure, and maintain MT4/MT5 servers (live, demo, and test) across AWS or other infrastructure environments.

Manage MetaTrader Admin/Manager terminals, including trading accounts, groups, permissions, and trading instrument configurations.

Support plugins, liquidity bridges, and trading integrations, working with trading and risk teams to implement new CFDs and trading conditions.
Reliability, Monitoring & Incident Management
•
Implement monitoring and alerting for platform health, latency, connectivity, and trading performance indicators.
•
Investigate and resolve platform incidents such as disconnects, abnormal trading activity, and system instability.

Perform log analysis and root cause investigations, contributing to incident reviews and reliability improvements.
AWS & Infrastructure Operations

Deploy and operate MetaTrader infrastructure on AWS, including EC2 instances, VPC networking, storage, and security groups.
•
Manage backups, snapshots, and infrastructure performance tuning to ensure system stability and availability.
•
Collaborate with engineering teams to implement Infrastructure-as-Code and secure infrastructure practices.
Integration & Ecosystem Support
•
Support integrations between MetaTrader and internal systems such as back office, CRM, client portals, and reporting tools.

Assist with connectivity to liquidity providers, trading bridges, and FIX integrations.
•
Work with developers and quant teams to deploy and test Expert Advisors (EAs), plugins, and custom components.
Platform Operations & Continuous Improvement

Maintain separate environments (dev, test, demo, live) with structured change and release processes.

Plan and execute platform upgrades, patches, and configuration changes with minimal disruption to trading operations.

Create and maintain runbooks, SOPs, and documentation while applying DevOps/SRE practices to improve reliability.

Hands-on experience supporting production trading platforms and operational environments.

Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, particularly in time-sensitive trading environments.

Good communication and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams including trading, risk, and engineering.

Join MyFundedFutures as the next QA Engineer responsible for ensuring that every release that reaches production meets a high bar for quality, stability, and correctness. This is a hands-on role with genuine ownership. You are the gate between code-complete and thousands of users.

You will work closely with product and engineering to define acceptance criteria, have thorough manual test and debugging skills, own the staging environment, build and maintain automation coverage and drive a culture where quality is everyone's responsibility and QA is the last line of defence, not an afterthought.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the QA gate for every release - nothing reaches production without the QA sign-off.

• Radiate knowledge of the trading products and asset classes the platform supports — including equities, futures, and leveraged instruments — so that test coverage reflects real-world user behavior, risk scenarios, and edge cases that matter in live trading environments.

• Stay current with changes to supported asset classes, new product offerings, and evolving platform capabilities; proactively update test plans and regression coverage as the product horizon expands.

• Execute end-to-end regression across all release tickets, verifying against defined acceptance criteria.

• Conduct production smoke tests of every production deploy, validating critical paths are intact.

• Maintain a stable, predictable Staging environment that PM and product can rely on for UAT.

• Build, maintain, and extend the automated regression suite covering critical user journeys: account creation, trading flows, payouts, and authentication.

• Own E2E test coverage; partner with developers on integration and API test coverage.

• Integrate regression suites into CI pipelines so every RC build is automatically validated before manual testing begins.

• Drive automation coverage toward a state where manual regression is focused on new features, not re-testing known-good functionality.

• File all bugs in Jira with clear reproduction steps, environment details as defined.

• Triage and prioritise incoming bugs; communicate release-blocking issues to the product engineering team.

• RanWork with developers during code review to ensure testability, meaningful test coverage, and that new features include adequate unit and integration tests before reaching QA.

• Support PM UAT on Staging - answer environment questions, provide test data, and reproduce issues on demand.

• Maintain test plans, test case documentation, and regression checklists as the authoritative QA reference.

• Document recurring issues, environment quirks, and common failure patterns so knowledge is not locked in one person.

Qualifications

Required

• Working knowledge of trading markets and financial instruments, including equities, futures, and leveraged asset classes. You understand how these products behave, what failure modes look like from a trader's perspective, and why accuracy and timing are non-negotiable in a live trading context.

• Proven experience as a QA Engineer on web and/or mobile software products with a structured, process-driven approach to release quality.

• Hands-on experience writing and maintaining automated E2E test suites using frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or similar.

• Solid understanding of the full QA lifecycle: test planning, regression execution, bug management, environment ownership, and release sign-off.

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and the ability to integrate test suites into automated build and release workflows.

• Experience with Jira or similar for bug tracking and release management

• Strong written communication skills - clear, precise bug reports and sign-off documentation are non-negotiable.

• Ability to work autonomously and alongside a team

• Reliable and thorough - you follow through, you don't rubber-stamp, and you treat the QA gate as a genuine responsibility.

Preferred

• Experience with React Native and/or Next.js web applications - familiarity with both mobile and web testing contexts.

• Background in fintech, trading platforms, or other regulated/high-stakes software environments where production quality is not negotiable.

• Experience with API testing tools (Postman or similar) and a solid understanding of REST and WebSocket APIs.

• Exposure to mobile testing via TestFlight and device-based regression for React Native applications.

• Familiarity with NX monorepos and multi-environment deployment pipelines (dev, staging, production).

• Experience maintaining QA documentation in Confluence or similar knowledge bases.

• Comfort operating across multiple products or teams simultaneously, helping manage parallel release cycles with independent cadences.

• Make each solution enterprise-ready: authentication and access control, secrets management, error handling, logging and monitoring, rate limiting and cost controls.

• Containerize solutions (Docker) and prepare for deployment on our cloud platform.

• Integrate AI solutions securely with internal systems and third-party tools such as CRM, Jira, data warehouses and internal APIs.

• Monitor solutions in production (performance, accuracy, cost, failures), troubleshoot incidents and roll out fixes and model updates.

• Set up and maintain evaluation and regression testing so that prompt or model changes don’t quietly break behaviour.

• Ensure solutions meet our data privacy, security and regulatory requirements, working with Compliance, InfoSec and Data teams.

• Produce and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, user guides and internal AI usage guidelines.

What do you need to succeed in this role?

• Experience in software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps or IT systems engineering, with production systems you have maintained yourself.

• Hands-on experience administering enterprise SaaS or AI platforms (e.g. Claude, Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot or Azure OpenAI), including user, license and policy management.

• Strong Python skills, plus experience with REST APIs, webhooks and system integrations.

• Hands-on experience deploying and operating LLM-based applications, such as RAG pipelines, agents, or tool and function calling.

• Working knowledge of Docker, CI/CD and Kubernetes concepts. You don’t need to run the cluster, but you must deliver workloads that run well on one.

• Experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure or GCP).

• A strong grasp of production practices: logging, monitoring, testing, versioning, secrets management and security.

• Ability to work with both technical and non-technical colleagues, and to push back constructively when something isn’t ready for production.

• A structured, documentation-minded approach and a high level of ownership.

Will be considered a plus:

• Experience with AWS Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

• Experience with Microsoft 365 / Entra ID administration.

• Experience in FinTech, brokerage, banking or another regulated industry.

• Experience with agent frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar) and vector databases.

• Familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation tools (e.g. Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize).

• Experience with MCP servers, Claude Code or similar developer AI tooling.

• Knowledge of workflow automation tools (n8n, Make, Power Automate) and business systems such as Jira and HubSpot.

• Understanding of data governance, GDPR and AI risk management.

By joining us, you can expect:

• Unique Opportunity for a career in a global, fast-growing company.

Mission of this role:

"This role exists for one purpose: to grow our Crypto business. The Senior Growth Manager will identify and execute disruptive, low-cost initiatives and forge strategic partnerships
that drive meaningful client acquisition within the crypto trading space — combining deep crypto-native intelligence with the ability to mobilise teams without direct authority."

This is not a generalist marketing role. We are looking for someone who lives and breathes crypto — who understands the industry's key players, audience psychology, trading behaviours, and community dynamics well enough to consistently spot growth opportunities that others miss, and act on them decisively.

Our Crypto business is a core strategic priority. We operate as a regulated crypto exchange serving traders across multiple global markets, and we are in a phase of aggressive client acquisition. This role is the dedicated engine of that growth — a specialist hire whose sole commercial focus is expanding our crypto client base through smart, high-leverage, low-cost initiatives and well-chosen partnerships.
The Senior Growth Manager will be specifically accountable for:
▸ Growing the number of active crypto traders on our platform — this is the primary mandate
▸ Expanding our presence and reputation within crypto-native communities, ecosystems, and media
▸ Identifying and activating partnership channels that are uniquely native to the crypto space — protocols, wallets, DAOs, launchpads, crypto media, KOLs, and Web3 infrastructure players

▸ Building the intelligence and playbook infrastructure that allows our teams to replicate and scale what works across regions and segments
▸ Positioning our exchange as the go-to platform for both crypto-native power users and the next wave of first-time crypto traders entering the market

K E Y R E S P O N S I B I L I T I E S
1. Disruptive, Low-Cost Crypto Growth Initiatives
▸ Own the identification and execution of growth plays specifically tailored to the crypto trading industry— not repurposed tactics from other verticals
▸ Continuously scan the crypto landscape to surface unconventional, high-leverage acquisition opportunities that competitors have overlooked: token launch moments, protocol migrations, bear/bull cycle sentiment shifts, regulatory tailwinds
▸ Design campaigns that resonate with crypto-native audiences — referral mechanics, viral on-chain incentives, community takeovers, co-marketing with Web3 projects, trading competitions, and airdrop- linked acquisition flows

▸ Prioritise and rank opportunities using a rigorous scoring framework (ICE / RICE), presenting a clear pipeline of crypto-specific 'low-hanging fruit' to the CRO each month
▸ Stress-test every initiative against acquisition metrics before committing resources, ensuring maximum new-client ROI on growth spend
2. Strategic Partnerships for Acquisition
▸ Identify, approach, and cultivate high-value partnerships with crypto-native projects, DeFi protocols, NFT platforms, Web3 wallets, crypto media, and adjacent fintech brands
▸ Build and maintain a structured partnership pipeline in collaboration with the Head of Business Development, tracking status from first contact to live activation
▸ Negotiate co-marketing, co-branding, and distribution agreements that drive measurable new-user
acquisition at low CAC
▸ Develop partnership playbooks — standardised frameworks that allow Regional Heads to replicate and localise proven partnership models in their markets
3. Crypto Industry Intelligence & Opportunity Spotting
▸ Serve as the team's primary authority on the crypto trading industry: its major exchanges, emerging protocols, DeFi trends, regulatory developments, audience segments, and shifting narratives
▸ Map the full crypto-native audience landscape — retail traders, DeFi power users, NFT participants, institutional desks, crypto-curious TradFi investors — and build targeted acquisition angles for each
▸ Track competitor exchange strategies (Binance, Coinbase, Bybit, OKX, Kraken and regional players) and identify positioning gaps our exchange can exploit for growth
▸ Monitor on-chain data, social sentiment, and market cycle dynamics to time growth campaigns for
maximum conversion impact
▸ Produce a recurring Crypto Growth Intelligence Brief shared with the CRO, Head of Marketing, and Regional Heads — translating market signals into actionable growth priorities
4. Playbook Creation & Cross-Functional Enablement
▸ Convert successful growth experiments and partnerships into repeatable, documented playbooks tha can be handed off to Marketing, BD, and Regional teams for scaled execution
▸ Brief internal teams — Marketing, Performance & Optimisation, Retention, and Regional Heads — with clear objectives, audience insights, messaging frameworks, and success metrics for each initiative
▸ Prepare and quality-control all necessary creative, content, and partnership assets in coordination with the relevant team owners
▸ Act as the internal growth authority: run workshops, share learnings, and upskill stakeholders on
emerging crypto growth tactics
5. Matrix Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence
▸ Build trusted working relationships across Marketing, BD, Retention, Performance, and Regional teams — establishing credibility through insight and results, not hierarchy
▸ Drive alignment in cross-functional planning sessions; proactively resolve conflicts between team
priorities that could slow growth execution
▸ Hold teams accountable to joint growth commitments through shared dashboards, regular syncs, and transparent reporting to the CRO
▸ Identify blockers early and escalate strategically, keeping initiative momentum without creating friction

R E Q U I R E M E N T S
Essential
▸ 5+ years in growth marketing, growth hacking, or strategic partnerships with direct, hands-on experience in the crypto or Web3 industry — this is non-negotiable

▸ Genuine, deep knowledge of the crypto trading industry as a practitioner: exchanges (CEX & DEX), DeFi mechanics, tokenomics, on-chain behaviour, and the communities, media, and influencers that shape the space
▸ Demonstrable track record of designing and executing low-budget, high-impact acquisition campaigns that drove meaningful growth in a crypto or fintech context
▸ Proven ability to spot under-exploited growth opportunities specific to crypto — a pattern-recognition
instinct for 'low-hanging fruit' in a fast-moving, cycle-driven market
▸ Experience building and managing strategic partnerships in the crypto ecosystem end-to-end: origination, negotiation, asset creation, and performance tracking
▸ Active participant in crypto communities (Twitter/X, Telegram, Discord, Farcaster) — you are known in the space, not just observing it
▸ Exceptional cross-functional influencing skills — a track record of driving results through teams you do not directly manage
▸ Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to author clear playbooks, briefs, and executive presentations
▸ Comfortable with analytics: able to define metrics, read dashboards, and draw actionable conclusions from data independently

Preferred
▸ Prior experience specifically at a crypto exchange (CEX) — you understand the unique acquisition funnel dynamics, KYC friction, and trading-lifecycle of exchange users
▸ Existing network of crypto-native contacts: KOLs, protocol BD leads, crypto fund operators, crypto media editors, or community leaders
▸ Hands-on experience with on-chain analytics tools: Dune Analytics, Nansen, Glassnode, or equivalent— able to derive audience and timing insights from on-chain data
▸ Experience designing and executing token incentive schemes, airdrops, or trading competitions as acquisition mechanisms
▸ Understanding of KYC/AML funnel implications and how to optimise conversion within regulatory constraints
▸ Multilingual or multi-market experience across key crypto growth markets: MENA, SEA, EU, Turkey, or LatAm

OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About The Opportunity

OKX is building local exchange businesses from the ground up across multiple emerging and high-growth markets. We are looking for a product leader who has driven a complete 0-to-1 cycle in a priority overseas market — someone who will own the product strategy and local growth playbook for a specific region or country, and be directly accountable for product competitiveness and business growth outcomes in that market.

This role sits at the intersection of the Local business team and Global product and engineering. You'll go deep into the local market — translating user profiles, regulatory landscapes, and competitive dynamics into product and growth strategies — while driving Global product and engineering resources to deliver locally, ensuring the product experience and competitiveness actually take off on the ground.

We are not prescriptive about which specific region you've built in previously — LatAm, Southeast Asia, Turkey, MENA, or others are all relevant. What matters is that you have personally built a business in an emerging market, closed the growth loop, and can transfer that methodology to OKX's priority regions.

This is a product leadership role, not a country general manager role — but you need to operate with near business-owner accountability: responsible for the region's core growth metrics and product competitiveness, not just shipping features.

What You’ll Be Doing

Regional Product Strategy & Local Growth Planning

•

Own product strategy and local growth planning for a specific region or country, working across the Local business team and Global product and engineering to be directly accountable for local product competitiveness and business growth outcomes.

•

Develop a deep understanding of local user profiles, legal and regulatory frameworks, competitive landscapes, and cultural nuances, and translate these into a comprehensive product competition strategy and channel growth strategy with clear prioritization.

•

Continuously track the local crypto and fintech ecosystem — with a focus on global players and regional leaders across exchanges and fintech — as well as macro factors such as inflation, currency depreciation, and cross-border remittance demand that shape user trading behavior.

Local Product Experience & Competitiveness

•

Own the end-to-end local product experience and competitiveness, covering onboarding, fiat deposit, market analysis, trading, and earn — the core stages of the user journey.

•

Build a comprehensive local product feedback loop — from user behavior data and funnel analysis, to local user feedback collection — to identify key bottlenecks and high-leverage opportunities in conversion, retention, and engagement, and drive iterative improvement.

•

Adapt to local market characteristics (inflation-driven demand, competitor switching costs, payment method preferences, etc.) to reduce drop-off from registration to first trade and shorten time-to-first-trade.

Channel Growth & Cross-team Collaboration

•

Work with local teams to identify effective user acquisition channels; lead the discovery, introduction, integration, and scaling of high-impact channels.

•

Leverage your local network — KOLs, fintech partners, payment providers, regulatory contacts — to accelerate market entry and growth.

•

Collaborate closely with regional BD, Marketing, Operations, and Global product and engineering to ensure product initiatives align with local growth objectives.

What We Look For In You

•

0-to-1 business building and growth experience in an emerging market (e.g., LatAm, Southeast Asia, Turkey, MENA, or similar) — you can clearly articulate the regional metrics you owned and the business outcomes you delivered. You held a product, strategy, or growth role during the early stage of an international expansion at a tech company or at a high-growth local champion in the region.

•

Comprehensive business growth and user growth methodology — you have fully owned a user funnel (acquisition → activation → retention) and can speak to results with data: CAC, activation rates, D7/D30 retention, LTV, reactivation. Your work was growth experimentation and product intervention, not just media buying.

•

Strong product management capability — you can define product strategy and success metrics, prioritize a roadmap, drive A/B testing, and collaborate with product and engineering to deliver. This is a product leadership role, not a GM or pure growth marketing role.

•

Proven cross-functional collaboration — able to drive alignment across teams (design, engineering, data, commercial), manage external partnerships, and navigate regulatory conversations. Effective at aligning resources between Local and Global organizations.

•

Deep local market knowledge and an established local network — you understand local user behaviors, payment ecosystems (e.g., PIX, SPEI, Mercado Pago, UPI, GCash, DANA, M-Pesa, depending on region), regulatory environments, and competitive dynamics. You have partners, KOLs, and industry relationships in the region that you can activate.

•

Consumer product management experience in fintech, crypto, or trading preferred. Candidates with experience managing or mentoring product teams will be considered for the Senior Product Director level.

•

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in Mandarin is a strong plus for effective collaboration with HQ teams.

Nice-To-Haves

•

Proficiency in a local language relevant to the target region (Spanish, Portuguese, Bahasa Indonesia, Arabic, Turkish, etc.).

•

Crypto exchange product experience — spot/derivatives trading, order types, fee structures, token listings, and fiat on/off-ramp flows.

•

Familiarity with local payment rails and fiat-to-crypto conversion flows in emerging markets.

•

Hands-on trading experience in FX, equities, or crypto.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

•

More that we love to tell you along the process!

Notice:

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

We are looking for a Senior Web Designer who combines strong visual craft and product thinking to design high-converting web experiences that drive measurable acquisition results. You will join our Brand Design team, working side by side with graphic, motion and 3d designers to shape how our brand lives on the web, and collaborate closely with product/marketing managers, analysts, and developers, where modern web design directly shapes how potential users discover our product and decide to sign up.

In this role, you will design and optimize our key acquisition surfaces (websites and landing pages), conduct qualitative research to understand visitor behavior, and translate insights into design improvements. You will set the visual direction for our web presence, influence design decisions, shape the brand experience on the web, and deliver measurable results for both the people who use our product and the company.

Responsibilities

• Design and evolve our key company websites with strong visual craft, with hand-off to WordPress developers for our main sites and to frontend developers for custom-built landings

• Design and continuously optimize landing pages and key website pages, focusing on clarity of message, engagement, and conversion to sign-up

• Build user flow maps and user journey maps to visualize and improve the acquisition experience end to end

• Conduct qualitative user research, including session recording analysis, heatmap reviews, user interviews, and usability testing, to uncover insights and inform design decisions

• Create app store creatives, including screenshots, feature graphics, and listing assets for App Store and Google Play

• Compose visually compelling layouts with strong typography, hierarchy, and visual rhythm

• Collaborate with graphic, 3D designers and other creative team members to integrate brand illustrations, photography, and visual assets into web layouts

• Adapt designs for multiple regions and languages, ensuring layouts, typography, and content systems work effectively across different markets and locales

• Ensure accessibility and responsiveness across different devices, adhering to brand guidelines and the web design system

• Document design decisions and guidelines for accurate implementation

Requirements

• 4+ years of experience designing landing pages, marketing websites, and registration flows

• Background that includes hands-on work with conversion metrics, A/B tests, qualitative research, and cross-functional collaboration with product managers and analysts

• Portfolio with recent (last 1 to 2 years) landing pages, marketing websites,home pages and registration flows demonstrating modern visual craft and conversion-focused thinking

• Strong visual design skills (typography, color theory, layout, hierarchy, composition) with a clear sense of modern web design trends and references

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) for visual design, asset preparation, and image editing

• Hands-on experience improving registration and sign-up flows by identifying friction through qualitative research and shipping iterative improvements

• Experience designing for acquisition, growth, or conversion-focused contexts with measurable impact

• Good qualitative research skills, including session recording analysis, heatmap interpretation, user interviews, and usability testing, with the ability to translate observations into actionable design hypotheses

• Proficiency in building user flow maps and user journey maps to visualize and communicate complex flows

• Experience creating app store creatives (screenshots, feature graphics, listing assets) for App Store and Google Play, with familiarity with ASO visual best practices

• Practical experience designing for both WordPress (page builders like Elementor or Gutenberg, reusable block patterns, dynamic content) and custom frontend hand-off, with basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for effective collaboration with developers across both stacks

• Proficiency in designing responsive user interfaces for web and mobile, grounded in user-centered design principles and information architecture

• Experience working within established design systems (components, tokens, guidelines) and proficiency in Figma for prototyping and rapid iteration

• Experience designing for multi-language and multi-regional products, with understanding of how localization affects layout, typography, content density, and visual hierarchy

• Proficient English skills (B2+ level) both written and spoken, with strong communication, teamwork, and a user-focused mindset with attention to detail

Will be a plus

• Experience using AI-powered tools (Midjourney, Krea, Runway, Figma AI plugins, Claude, or similar) in your design workflow

Who we are

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Are you ready to shape the future of finance?

Bitpanda, one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintech companies, is building something game-changing, and we want you to be part of it.

We’re launching a brand-new Operations division with one clear purpose: to deliver premium, world-class support to our users, with a strong focus on phone-based customer service.
We’re looking for people who are confident communicators, thrive in real-time conversations, and genuinely enjoy helping customers over the phone.

This new team will be a cornerstone of Bitpanda’s future, ensuring millions of users receive fast, friendly, and reliable support. By joining, you won’t just step into a role, you’ll directly shape how people experience Bitpanda every single day and play a key part in how we redefine the way the world invests.

What You’ll Do (Day-to-Day)

As part of Bitpanda’s new Operations division, you will:

• Provide world-class service to our users primarily through phone support, and occasionally via tickets or live chat, always delivering timely, professional assistance that drives satisfaction and loyalty

• Align daily with your manager and collaborate closely to meet team and company targets

• Dive into user feedback to identify key product or feature requests and share meaningful insights with internal teams

• Spot opportunities to streamline and improve support processes

• Partner with other departments to elevate customer satisfaction and help boost our Net Promoter Score (NPS)

Who We’re Looking For

We’re searching for ambitious, adaptable, and curious people who:

• Experience in phone-based customer support, is a plus

• Communicate clearly and professionally

• Are fluent in German (C2) and comfortable in English (B2+)

• Thrive in a fast-moving, dynamic environment and are open to shift work (including evenings/weekends)

• Have experience with tools like Zendesk (a plus, not a must)

• Are interested in fintech, crypto, or financial markets (optional but beneficial)

What’s in it for you

• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.

• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.

• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.

• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.

• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.

• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.

• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

.…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

Drive product roadmap for key components of AI and agent platforms or application products, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs

Collaborate with UX teams to ensure optimal user experience across various Alexa-enabled devices and surfaces

Build strong partnerships with stakeholders across the company, including Science, Engineering, Design, Business Development, and Legal teams

•

Drive technical decisions that balance customer experience, technical feasibility, and business requirements

•

Identify and assess new opportunities for applying emerging AI technologies to enhance Alexa's capabilities

Strong technical background and proven track record of delivering complex technical products at scale

Experience working with technical teams and managing complex stakeholder relationships

Master's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, analytics, mathematics, IT or equivalent

Experience with conversational AI or voice-based products

•

Strong technical understanding of ML/AI concepts, particularly in NLP and LLMs

•

Track record of innovation and zero-to-one product development

•

Experience with Deep Learning model training or inference

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Team

Product managers at OKX are the CEOs of their areas of focus. We develop growth-focused product strategies, manage cost/profitability and then deliver powerful strategies that guide customers through simple transaction workflows. We are building an integrated and beautiful crypto-finance experience for mobile and web. Product managers collaborate across business units and align user research, design and UX writing, brand and marketing, technical project management and engineering, testing, data, compliance and legal teams. We are a multi-cultural and decentralized team with a deep passion for bitcoin, crypto and Defi. We are objective oriented and everyone contributes to data analysis to drive business growth.

About the Opportunity

As the Product Manager, you will be responsible to discover new markets and revenue opportunities and innovate new products to address the market needs. Act as an internal champion to build consensus and influence senior management for new product ideas. Identify, define, implement and instrument market research, product design, product implementation and product release processes.

Define, build and scale OKX's payment systems that powers money movement globally to help our customers gain access to a wide array of crypto assets. The scope of this role includes defining & managing product roadmaps, features including user experience and end to end integration with local & international payment providers while proactively managing the risk associated with your product. Tracking KPIs and driving growth of your product features is at the core of PM’s at OKX, while collaborating with multiple key stakeholders like designers, engineering, legal, risk, compliance, marketing, customer support & finance across the organization and get them aligned on your product roadmap and deliverables.

You’ll be joining our growing product team to help define the future of our company and product. If you are an entrepreneurial product leader, who doesn’t hesitate to propose bold ideas and roll up your sleeves to put them into action, this role will be a great fit for you.

What You'll Be Doing

•

Be the owner of your payment products (ACH, Cards, Wire, SEPA, FAST, PIX, etc), you truly own it!

•

Define & drive every aspect of your product from developing the roadmap/backlogs/iterations in order to hit your goals & KPIs

•

Outline features, technical integration requirements, work with your squad of product designers, content writers, data analysts and engineers to bring your product to life

•

You verify your squad deliverables, align your customer support teams including all key stakeholders for any feature release/announcements to your retail users

•

Manage your product dashboard by tracking all your product data metrics

•

Drive adoption, usage of your products working closely with marketing, risk teams, keep close eye on customer frictions and voice of customer to optimize your product experience

•

Ensure that there are effective internal tools in place for any new product launch

•

Product management experience in the payments space with past experience in payments clearing, settlement and fiat custody

•

Visionary for trending and future crypto market needs and payments industry changes

•

Product innovator that can achieve business goals with unique product offering and business models

•

Previous experience designing and building payments systems and understanding of risk management associated with these payment options

•

Entrepreneurial mindset: Experience working in a fast-paced environment with competing resources and priorities. Opinionated and willing to make calls with limited information. Ability to navigate through ambiguity to advocate for resources

•

Excellent written and verbal communications skills; ability to translate strategy into clear and actionable plans for product development, engineering, design and marketing

•

Technical, comfortable with delving into the product, the platform and the implementation details. Able to engage with engineering beyond just product and user experience needs; willing to roll up sleeves and design scalable and extensible solutions

•

Metrics driven with proficiency in identifying, defining, tracking and acting upon metrics Experience identifying KPIs and working with engineering and analytics on instrumentation and monitoring

•

Familiarity with cryptocurrency exchanges and passion for crypto and blockchain innovations

•

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline

Nice to Haves

Past experience working with payments systems or crypto platforms is strongly preferred

会社紹介
ビットバンクはSBIグループの一員として新たな成長を目指す、暗号資産専業のスタートアップ企業です。
「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」をミッションに暗号資産技術の応用によって、人々の生活にビットコインが浸透し普及することを目指しています。
180名を超える社員のうち、20代〜30代のメンバーが約70％と若手中心ですが、40代以上の経験豊富なベテランも多数在籍しています。
同じビジョンを共有するメンバーが、それぞれの専門性を活かしながら、日々挑戦と成長を重ねています。私たちは当社が掲げるVision、Missionに共感し、そして3つのValuesを大切にしています。

募集背景
ビットバンクは「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」をミッションに、暗号資産取引所サービスを提供しています。
暗号資産取引所は金融サービスとしてセキュリティや可用性が最重要ですが、インターネットサービスとしてスピードや柔軟性も求められます。
プロダクト開発を担う組織の一つであるリテールシステム部では、暗号資産取引所のうち多くのお客様が直接手に触れるモバイルアプリやWebフロントエンドをはじめとして、それらを支えるバックエンドAPIやサービスも含めたお客様向けの機能全体（=リテールシステム）を開発・運用しています。
このようなチャレンジングな環境で、お客様に最高の暗号資産取引体験を提供するために、一緒に奮闘してくれる仲間を募集しています。

This role is responsible for developing and managing end-to-end media strategies to generate quality leads, drive registrations, and increase active user engagement. The role involves optimizing campaigns daily to meet key KPIs (CPL, CVR, CPC, CPA) and ensuring strong ROAS.

• Be an audience master who works with Data Analysis, Business Development, Marketing campaigns, and Marketing Communication to define the potential customer segments among several ads platforms and owned media channels to maximize the conversion rate efficacy
• Monitor digital customer behavior and Identify new MarTech tools to gather online marketing insight, performance analytic thought in the digital landscape, and mobile-app marketing

暗号資産の社会的認知度の向上に伴い、事業者に求められるコンプライアンスの水準も日々高まっています。また、技術的なイノベーション等により経営環境が急速に変化し、新たなサービスや取引手法・取引形態が登場することで、コンプライアンス上のリスクも増大します。
その為、暗号資産交換業（取引所・販売所の運営）に関する業規制を基盤としつつ、ビジネスモデルの多様化・複雑化の折には、銀行法、信託法、金融商品取引法、貸金業法、資金決済法（資金移動業、前払式支払手段）といった他の業規制への対応も、常に視野に入れておくことが重要です。
これらに対し、最適な内部管理態勢をどのように構築・運用するか、守り（事業継続）と攻め（事業成長の支援）双方の視点を持った方からのエントリーをお待ちしております。

会社紹介
ビットバンクはSBIグループの一員として新たな成長を目指す、暗号資産専業のスタートアップ企業です。
「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」をミッションに暗号資産技術の応用によって、人々の生活にビットコインが浸透し普及することを目指しています。
180名を超える社員のうち、20代〜30代のメンバーが約70％と若手中心ですが、40代以上の経験豊富なベテランも多数在籍しています。
同じビジョンを共有するメンバーが、それぞれの専門性を活かしながら、日々挑戦と成長を重ねています。私たちは当社が掲げるVision、Missionに共感し、そして3つのValuesを大切にしています。
■主なサービス
【bitbank. cc】
ビットコインをはじめ幅広く取り揃えた豊富な銘柄を取り扱っており、シンプルで軽量なデザインに加え、高い機能性を備えたスマートな取引所です。
また、金融庁の認可を受けた暗号資産交換業者として、安全性と信頼性の高い取引環境を実現しています
■子会社情報
【Bitbank Ventures合同会社（Bitbank Ventures）】
Bitbank Ventures株式会社は、ビットバンク株式会社の100%出資により設立された投資子会社です。
暗号資産やブロックチェーンによるインターネット上の新たな価値移転の可能性に加え、AI技術の進化により注目される「AI × クリプト」領域など、将来を見据えた先端技術の動向を的確に捉えながら、未来の社会を支える革新的な取り組みを支援することを目的としています。

ビットバンクはSBIグループの一員として新たな成長を目指す、暗号資産専業のスタートアップ企業です。
「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」をミッションに暗号資産技術の応用によって、人々の生活にビットコインが浸透し普及することを目指しています。
180名を超える社員のうち、20代〜30代のメンバーが約70％と若手中心ですが、40代以上の経験豊富なベテランも多数在籍しています。
同じビジョンを共有するメンバーが、それぞれの専門性を活かしながら、日々挑戦と成長を重ねています。私たちは当社が掲げるVision、Missionに共感し、そして3つのValuesを大切にしています。
■主なサービス
【bitbank. cc】
ビットコインをはじめ幅広く取り揃えた豊富な銘柄を取り扱っており、シンプルで軽量なデザインに加え、高い機能性を備えたスマートな取引所です。
また、金融庁の認可を受けた暗号資産交換業者として、安全性と信頼性の高い取引環境を実現しています
■子会社情報
【Bitbank Ventures合同会社（Bitbank Ventures）】
Bitbank Ventures株式会社は、ビットバンク株式会社の100%出資により設立された投資子会社です。
暗号資産やブロックチェーンによるインターネット上の新たな価値移転の可能性に加え、AI技術の進化により注目される「AI × クリプト」領域など、将来を見据えた先端技術の動向を的確に捉えながら、未来の社会を支える革新的な取り組みを支援することを目的としています。

募集背景
現在、ビットバンクでは株式のように投資家が自ら売り手、買い手となり取引をマッチングさせる暗号資産取引所「bitbank.cc」を主軸にサービスを展開しています。bitbank.ccを利用するのは個人だけでなく法人のお客様も多く、またAPIを利用したシステムトレードも活発に行われています。
プロダクトマネージャーは、このような多様なお客様のニーズに応えながら、暗号資産の強みを最大限に活かし、日本だけでなくグローバルなマーケットで通用するプロダクトを作り上げることができるポジションです。
テクノロジーと金融の融合した暗号資産取引所のプロダクトマネージャーとして、これまでの経験を活かしご活躍いただけませんか？
仕事内容
（雇入直後）

• 暗号資産取引所および社内システムの企画、新機能を立案し、実現するための仕様策定

• 顧客ニーズや世の中のトレンドをキャッチアップし、企画・立案

• 企画内容は新サービス、新機能、法令書規則への対応、UI/UXの改善

• プロダクト開発に責任を持ち、各ステークホルダーを巻き込んでプロダクトチームの開発サイクルをリード

• 作成した企画の実現に向け、ステークホルダーを巻き込みながら開発のリード

（変更の範囲）

• 同上

必須条件

• 当社のVision/Mission/Valuesに共感できる方

• Fintechなどの金融業界での実務経験

• 金融系取引システムの企画/開発/運営に携わった経験

• 金融系取引システムのプロジェクト管理、もしくはプロダクト管理の経験

• エンジニアやデザイナー、他職種、外部企業との連携を行いながら、プロジェクト推進した経験

歓迎条件

• toC向けの自社Web/APPでのプロダクト開発の推進

• UXリサーチ業務

• BigQueryやGoogle Analyticsなどを用いたデータ抽出、検証の分析

• カスタマージャーニーマップ等を行い、顧客視点に立ったプロダクトの設計・開発の推進

本ポジションの魅力

• 暗号資産という最先端業界でユーザーと向き合いながらサービスの企画・運営ができる

• 堅実さが求められる金融業界の側面と、スピード感が求められるWeb業界の側面をもち、イニシアチブを取りながらプロダクトを成長させることができる

• ユーザーのみならず暗号資産業界全体に貢献できる

求める人物像

• 暗号資産やブロックチェーンへの強い興味をお持ちの方

• 金融商品の取引システムに強い興味をお持ちの方

• 考えやアイデアを論理的に説明し、各関係部署やステークホルダーと円滑にコミュニケーションできる方

• 市場調査やユーザー行動分析を通じて、データに基づいた戦略的な判断ができる方

会社紹介
ビットバンクはSBIグループの一員として新たな成長を目指す、暗号資産専業のスタートアップ企業です。
「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」をミッションに暗号資産技術の応用によって、人々の生活にビットコインが浸透し普及することを目指しています。
180名を超える社員のうち、20代〜30代のメンバーが約70％と若手中心ですが、40代以上の経験豊富なベテランも多数在籍しています。
同じビジョンを共有するメンバーが、それぞれの専門性を活かしながら、日々挑戦と成長を重ねています。私たちは当社が掲げるVision、Missionに共感し、そして3つのValuesを大切にしています。
■主なサービス
【bitbank. cc】
ビットコインをはじめ幅広く取り揃えた豊富な銘柄を取り扱っており、シンプルで軽量なデザインに加え、高い機能性を備えたスマートな取引所です。
また、金融庁の認可を受けた暗号資産交換業者として、安全性と信頼性の高い取引環境を実現しています
■子会社情報
【Bitbank Ventures合同会社（Bitbank Ventures）】
Bitbank Ventures株式会社は、ビットバンク株式会社の100%出資により設立された投資子会社です。
暗号資産やブロックチェーンによるインターネット上の新たな価値移転の可能性に加え、AI技術の進化により注目される「AI × クリプト」領域など、将来を見据えた先端技術の動向を的確に捉えながら、未来の社会を支える革新的な取り組みを支援することを目的としています。

Who we are

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Security is fundamental to the trust millions of customers place in Bitpanda every day. As an Cyber Security Engineer, you'll help protect our platform by detecting threats, responding to incidents and continuously improving the security of our cloud-native environment. Working alongside experienced security engineers, you'll build detections, automate repetitive tasks and investigate security events that help keep our infrastructure, applications and customers safe.

What you'll do

• Build and improve detections. Develop, test and tune detection rules in Elastic Security (ES|QL/KQL), helping improve detection coverage, reduce false positives and ensure meaningful threats are identified quickly.

• Investigate security events and hunt for threats. Respond to security alerts, participate in incident response, perform proactive threat hunting across AWS, Elastic and Datadog, and contribute to improving investigation and response processes.

• Automate security operations. Build scripts, API integrations and SOAR workflows that reduce manual effort, improve investigation quality and help the Security team operate more efficiently.

• Help secure our cloud platform. Monitor AWS security events, investigate suspicious activity, contribute to system hardening and security tooling improvements, and support initiatives that strengthen Bitpanda's overall security posture.

• Contribute to a strong security culture. Work closely with engineers across the business, support compliance activities including ISO 27001, PCI DSS and DORA, and help promote security best practices throughout the organisation.

• Keep millions of users safe, no matter the time of day. As part of this commitment, you'll participate in a weekly rotating on-call schedule alongside the rest of the team.

Who you are

• You have 2–4 years of experience in information security, security engineering or security operations, with exposure to incident response, SIEM, threat hunting or cloud security.

• You enjoy solving technical security problems and have experience writing scripts or automating workflows using APIs or security tooling.

• You have a solid understanding of AWS or another major cloud platform, networking fundamentals, system hardening and security monitoring. Experience with Elastic Security, ES|QL or KQL is a big plus!

• You're curious, proactive and eager to learn, taking ownership of your work while seeking opportunities to improve both security and operational efficiency.

• You're passionate about keeping millions of users safe, no matter the time of day; This role has on call responsibilities that rotate through the team on a weekly basis.

What’s in it for you

• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.

• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.

• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.

• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.

• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.

• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.

• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

.…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

As Markets Control & Analytics Lead, you will drive P&L transparency, pricing and hedging analytics, front-to-back operational KPIs, and robust control frameworks across traditional and digital asset classes. Who you are

• Education: Degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting or a related field; CFA, CPA or ACCA is a plus.

• Experience: 7+ years in front-office (e.g., Quant Trading) or middle-office (e.g., Product Control, Trading Operations) roles within banking, trading or fintech.

• Markets Knowledge: Strong understanding of trading P&L, hedging and inventory risk across asset classes, including P&L bases such as cash, FIFO, average cost and mark-to-market. Experience with crypto, stablecoins, precious metals or FX is a plus.

• Technical Skills: Proficient in Excel, SQL, Python or similar tools, with experience in analytics, dashboards and automation.

• Mindset: Hands-on, analytical and entrepreneurial, with the ownership and drive to build and scale a high-impact function.

What’s in it for you

• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

• 制定並執行業務開發策略，開發新客戶並擴大香港市場佔有率
• 以粵語透過即時聊天、電子郵件與電話等方式，提供專業、迅速的客戶服務
• 回應客戶問題，並提供交易平台、服務及市場機會的完整資訊
• 產品知識：隨時掌握外匯產品、市場趨勢與產業動態，向客戶清楚說明我們的產品優勢
• 達成目標：持續達成甚至超越業績指標
• 跨部門合作：與研究、行銷與客服團隊緊密協作，確保客戶擁有無縫體驗
• 建立與維繫現有客戶關係，促進客戶留存並開發交叉銷售機會
• 維護正確的客戶資料，並定期提供業務開發進度與市場洞察報告

• 客戶滿意度卓越：提供專業、即時、具文化敏感度的服務，穩定提升香港客戶的滿意度與忠誠度
• 市場擴張影響力：透過關係建立與策略開發，使 VT Markets 在大中華區與香港成為知名且值得信賴的品牌
• 營收成長貢獻：藉由開發新客戶、深化關係管理與行銷活動轉化潛在用戶為活躍交易者，推動明顯的業務成長

學歷與工作經驗

• 商業、金融、行銷或相關科系學士學位
• 2–3 年以上業務開發、銷售或客戶服務經驗，金融服務或金融科技產業尤佳
• 具備成功開發客戶與達成業績目標的實績技術與功能技能

• 中文與粵語為母語或流利，具備優秀的中英文書寫與口說能力
• 熟悉金融市場與交易平台；若具備外匯知識尤佳
• 熟悉 CRM 系統、Microsoft Office 及各類數位溝通工具軟性技能

• 優秀的溝通能力與跨文化人際互動技巧
• 強烈的問題解決能力與以客為尊的服務精神
• 優異的組織管理能力，能同時管理多位客戶關係其他要求

• 願意參與不定期的線下推廣活動、客戶拜訪或區域團隊合作

我們的福利

• 績效獎金制度：讓您的努力直接反映於獎勵上，激勵您持續成長與貢獻
• 職涯發展機會：我們將提供培訓、導師指導與持續學習機會，協助您邁向職涯下一步

應徵流程

• 主管面談：與直屬主管進行第一輪面試
• 高階主管面談：第二輪與更高一層主管進行面談
